fiscal.equivalence_note: Canada has no DTS with receipts/withdrawals, but the Receiver General publishes a DAILY closing cash balance at the BoC plus term deposits placed with banks (found in triangulation, verified 2026-09-08). Daily -dBalance is the analog of -dTGA; term deposits capture cash moved from the BoC to banks (reserve-adding without fiscal meaning). Issuance/redemption from auctions; net spending from monthly Fiscal Monitor (deferred).

derived.mmt_note: Spending creates NFA; taxes destroy NFA; bond issuance drains reserves but does NOT change NFA (composition swap). Reserve impact and NFA creation are tracked as two separate lines (triangulation consensus).

derived_v04.components_v04: shadow: net_issuance_5d_pct, rg_am_net_5d_pct (% of weekly reserves) + fiscal_flow_z (v0.3). NOT in the live score until the replay

corra_dispersion_bps.label: CORRA intraday dispersion

corra_iqr_bps.note: v0.4 C6: interquartile dispersion of CORRA; context

secondary_absolute.origin: v2.0 corraPolicySpread (green <0, amber 0-5, red >5); crisis level added
secondary_absolute.note: floor-system regime: CORRA persistently above target = reserve scarcity signal
+5 = CORRA at target; +10 = today (2026-09-03); >= +30 = CORRA at Bank Rate ceiling

methodology_notes: CORRA is compared to V39079 (target), never to V39078 (Bank Rate) nor to deposit rate; do NOT subtract 25 bps (rescued from v2.0 README).
Spreads on common dates only (mergeSeries rule).
Deposit rate = target - 5 bp since 2025-01-30 (BoC notice 2025-01-29). Reviewers claiming a +/-25 bp corridor with deposit = target - 25 were wrong: Bank Rate is target + 25, deposit is target - 5.

regime.weights_note: triangulation consensus: fiscal lowered from 0.30 (proxy), rates raised (daily, price-based); revisit fiscal weight once RG daily data validated over one issuance cycle

rules.LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY: reserves BELOW boc_target_range (absolute) AND overnight_minus_deposit_bps >= STRESS
rules.FLOOR_FRICTION: reserves within boc_target_range AND overnight_minus_deposit_bps >= watch (CORRA above target while reserves are ample: distribution friction, not aggregate scarcity)
rules.LIQUIDITY_DRAIN: general regime: central bank AND treasury both DRAIN, or dual-weighted score ≤ drain threshold (regime.dual)
rules.LIQUIDITY_INJECTION: general regime: both INJECTION, or dual-weighted score ≥ injection threshold (regime.dual)
rules.NEUTRAL: otherwise (including unresolved conflicts inside the thresholds)

orthogonal_flags.TRANSMISSION_FAILURE: banking.transmission_signal == RED while reserves within/above range (credit contracting despite ample liquidity)

dual.status: calibrated by replay 2026-09-09 (engine v0.3, era 2020-03-23, 337 weeks)

central_bank.rule: era p80/p20 (exit p67/p33) of the 7-day mean score, nearest attainable, exit after 0 days inside

fiscal.rule: era p80/p20 (exit p67/p33) of the 7-day mean score, nearest attainable, exit after 0 days inside

dual.rule: three regimes per currency (engine v0.3): central_bank and fiscal from their block score with era-calibrated entry/exit cuts on the 7-day mean score; general = agreement only (both inject → LIQUIDITY_INJECTION, both drain → LIQUIDITY_DRAIN, partial or conflict → NEUTRAL labelled); percentile windows anchored to era_start; price gates (LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY, FLOOR_FRICTION) override the general regime

regime.composite_note: weights (4 blocks) now produce the desk composite score for context; the reported regime is the general regime (central bank + treasury)

dual_v02.rule: three regimes per currency: central_bank (block score), fiscal (block score), general = agreement (both inject → LIQUIDITY_INJECTION, both drain → LIQUIDITY_DRAIN); a conflict is resolved by the dual-weighted score against general_thresholds; price gates (LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY, FLOOR_FRICTION) override the general regime

architecture.storage: git (kept: GitHub-web-UI workflow, versioned audit trail); revisit object storage if repo > 500 MB

mitigations.json_size: data/{ccy}/*.json hold latest + 52-week compact history only; full history appended to history/{ccy}/*.csv (append-only, no rewrites)
mitigations.concurrency: one workflow file with currency matrix; concurrency group per currency to serialize commits
mitigations.heartbeat: every JSON carries generated_at and as_of; frontend and agent show DEGRADED if generated_at older than 2x lane period
mitigations.cron_keepalive: GitHub disables scheduled workflows after 60 days without repo activity — workflow commits count, plus a monthly keepalive step
mitigations.cdn_cache: Netlify headers: Cache-Control no-cache for data/*.json
mitigations.id_drift: ingestion validates each series label against config label on every run; mismatch -> unavailable + SOURCE_ERROR log
mitigations.idempotency: runs are re-executable; revision detection diffs against last committed JSON
